summary: Ashford Hospitality Trust, Inc. (AHT) filed an 8-K reporting the completion of the sale of the Marriott Fremont Silicon Valley, a 357-room hotel in Fremont, California. The sale closed on July 1, 2026, for approximately $52.2 million in cash, net of selling expenses, under an Agreement of Purchase and Sale dated June 19, 2026, with SRE Acquisitions V, LLC as purchaser. The company also paid about $43.5 million to the mortgage lender, which holds a loan secured by 14 hotels including this property. No board recommendation or advisor is disclosed. Key watch: potential further asset sales to reduce debt and improve liquidity.
